keyEvents.text: Maxi Araújo (Sporting Lisbon) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Sergi Altimira (Sporting Lisbon) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sporting Lisbon 1, CD Nacional 0. Luis Suárez (Sporting Lisbon) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Léo Santos (CD Nacional).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Sporting Lisbon 1, CD Nacional 0.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Deivison replaces Léo Santos because of an injury.
Markus Jensen (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sporting Lisbon 2, CD Nacional 0. Flávio Gonçalves (Sporting Lisbon) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Luis Suárez.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Allen Obando replaces Pablo Ruan.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Chiheb Laabidi replaces Markus Jensen.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Luís Guilherme replaces Geny Catamo.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Nestory Irankunda replaces Rodrigo Zalazar.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Fotis Ioannidis replaces Luis Suárez.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Matchoi Djaló replaces Stavros Gavriel.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Georgios Vagiannidis replaces Maxi Araújo.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Daniel Júnior replaces Miguel Baeza.
